findings.title: Removing findMany breaks the existing service API
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany(findManyArgs)` method with `getBaseConditions()`, but the PR only migrates the integration test and does not provide a compatibility method or migrate production consumers. Existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` will no longer compile (or will throw at runtime), and a SQL condition is not a drop-in replacement for the previous query execution, selection, and pagination API. Preserve the existing method until consumers are migrated, or include the consumer migrations in this change.
